label: Open source
description: The product's source code is published under an open source licence, at least for a core edition.

label: Self-hosting
description: At least one edition of the product can run on servers the organiser controls.

label: No per-ticket platform fee
description: The platform charges no mandatory fee of its own on each ticket sold. A voluntary contribution the organiser can decline counts as none, and payment processing is separate.

label: No marketing to attendees
description: The review records no platform marketing, adverts or event recommendations sent to the organiser's attendees.

label: UK based
description: The review places the provider's registration or operating base in the United Kingdom.

label: Charity, co-op, CIC or B Corp
description: The review records a charity registration, a community interest company, a certified B Corporation or a self-described worker co-operative.

label: White label
description: The organiser's branding can fully replace the platform's, whether included, on a higher tier, as a paid add-on or by self-hosting.

label: Custom domain
description: Ticket pages can run on a domain the organiser chooses, including via the platform the product installs into.

label: Website builder
description: The product includes a public website with pages the organiser can compose, not only event or booking pages.

label: API
description: The review records a documented API, whether on every plan, on a higher tier or read-only.

label: Seating plans
description: Attendees can pick seats from a seat map, whether included, on a higher tier or as a paid option.

label: Running for 5+ years
description: The start year documented in the review is at least five years ago.

label: Event marketplace
description: Events can be listed in a public directory the provider runs, which can bring attendees the organiser did not reach.
